stem: What percentage of pediatric presentations to private practice settings are estimated to be related to musculoskeletal complaints?
explanation: Musculoskeletal symptoms are very common, representing nearly one-third of pediatric presentations in private practice.
rationale: Consider the frequency of these complaints mentioned at the beginning of the lecture.

optionExplanations.A: While musculoskeletal issues are frequent, this figure underestimates the actual prevalence cited for primary care pediatric settings.
optionExplanations.B: Musculoskeletal symptoms are very common, representing nearly one-third of pediatric presentations in private practice.
optionExplanations.C: Although common, musculoskeletal complaints do not constitute half of all pediatric visits to private clinics.
optionExplanations.D: This figure is much higher than the actual frequency of musculoskeletal complaints relative to other pediatric health issues.
